verdict.rationale: Clerk documents an official remote MCP server that AI agents such as Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot can connect to. The Clerk CLI connects it to AI clients in one command, and a probe confirms the documentation page exists. The server's scope is limited to Clerk SDK snippets and implementation patterns rather than operating on live Clerk resources. Missing for 10: MCP tools for managing users, orgs, or other application data; independent or hands-on corroboration of the server in use.
